title: MongoDB Extended JSON to Plain JSON

seo.title: MongoDB Extended JSON to Plain JSON — Private Browser Tool | AafnaiPatro
seo.meta_description: Normalize Extended JSON v2 markers while explicitly preserving non-JSON BSON types in tagged wrappers. Runs locally in your browser. Review limitations and examples.
seo.h1: BSON shape inspector: MongoDB Extended JSON to Plain JSON

limits: Plain JSON cannot preserve all BSON type semantics. Wrapper mode retains BSON markers as strings/tags; unrecognized markers stay unchanged and are warned about.
